corrections.reason: The genitive prefix before the numeral ፭ is 1st-order የ (የ፭ አዕማደ ምሥጢር), parallel to የ፭ቱ on the following line.
The word is ጦራቸው ('their spiritual warfare/weapon'), matching ጦራቸው in lines 32 and 36; a faint center leg caused ጦ to be misread as ፆ.
The word is ጦር ('spear/warfare'), matching ጦር in line 34; faint ink on the middle leg of ጦ made it look like ፆ.
Same glyph ጦር ('warfare/temptation') with a lightly inked middle leg misread as ፆር.
The word is በሌላ ጦር ('with another weapon/temptation'), matching በሌላ ጦር in lines 33-34.
The image clearly prints the archaic Andemta form የሁነው with 2nd-order ሁ (bottom-right stroke visible), not የሆነው.
Joining across the line wrap gives አስፈቅዶ ('having asked permission/consent'), and the glyph at the end of line 37 is 1st-order አ without a center loop.
The third character has the top-right hook of 6th-order ል (የቀልብላብነቱን, 'out of his own hastiness/meddling').
Joined with line 2 (አይደለ-), the word is አይደለምን ('is it not?'). Visually the first character of line 3 clearly has the double loops and descender of ም, not ል.
The Classical Ge'ez imperative of ነሥአ is ንሣእ (with 6th-order ን), and the top bend of ን is clearly visible on the page.
Joined with line 34 (-ዳሜ), the word is ቅዳሜ ('Saturday', matching line 35), and the final character on line 33 has the horizontal crossbar projection of 6th-order ቅ.
